title: The Solar Empress
metaDescription: 19.99ct Fancy Yellow center stone — foliate garland of marquise and pear-cut diamonds, graduating collar of round brilliants in platinum. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Flanking the center, a dramatic fan of marquise and pear-cut white diamonds radiates outward in a foliate garland motif — movement frozen in platinum. Two graduated rows of round brilliant diamonds complete the collar, sweeping the neck in a seamless arc of white light.

specs.label: Supporting Stones
specs.body: Marquise and pear-cut white diamonds in foliate garland arrangement. Two graduated rows of round brilliant diamonds completing the collar.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private appointment.
